companyInfo.Footnote: A mutual company, not a stock company. It is grouped with stock companies because it reports according to Generally Accepted Accounting Principles.

description: Mutual of Omaha Insurance Company is a mutual life insurance company that offers services to individuals, families, and businesses in the United States. Its products include Medicare supplements, disability income, and dental insurance, as well as term, whole, and universal life policies. The company was known as Mutual Benefit Health and Accident Association until it changed its name to Mutual of Omaha in 1962. In 2025, the company announced a plan to reorganize under a mutual holding company structure owned by policyholders.

title: Mutual of Omaha

rankings.title: 100 Best Large Workplaces for Women
rankings.itemDescription:
Employees say:

"Mutual of Omaha is by far the best company I have ever worked for because of our culture. Senior leaders lead by example and genuinely care about people, both internal associates and our customers. I have never felt like I could be my full, authentic self at work until I began working here. Our leaders have recognized that everyone is different and have committed to allowing people to work where we work best, which for me is remotely. I am grateful to have had many opportunities to collaborate with awesome people, share my ideas, and contribute my talents. I can't imagine working anywhere else."

rankings.title: Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For
rankings.itemDescription:
The financial services provider earned a spot on the Best Companies list thanks in part to its dedication to its diversity and inclusion goals.

  • Mutual of Omaha joined the Maverick Mentoring Pilot program, which partners with the University of Nebraska at Omaha and matches associates with first-generation college students to mentor.

  • Culture Espressos is a new program that provides employees with a concentrated 15-minute discussion that focuses on different concepts each month and provides activities and discussion ideas to take back to their teams.

  • The company helped found the Siembra project, joining a group of companies in partnership with the Latino Center of the Midlands to help recruit and prepare high school students for internship programs.

  • Mutual of Omaha regularly reviews its benefits program. In 2022, it enhanced bereavement leave, increased the lifetime benefit for infertility, increased the tuition reimbursement benefit, added a voluntary hospital indemnity insurance plan, increased the subsidy for employees who adopt children, and kept the employee premium for the 2023 medical plan within 3% of last year’s premium.

rankings.title: Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For
rankings.itemDescription: The 113-year-old insurer focuses on developing—and keeping—its talent. Every year, the company invests half its general and administrative budget in its workforce, making available opportunities like one-on-one career coaching, digital skills training, and professional advancement programs. For example, employees who want to pursue a career in tech and app development at the company are invited to apply to a local coding school. Mutual of Omaha will cover the cost of tuition and materials, and offer them a job at the other end. Managers, meanwhile, go through in-depth accountability training, focused particularly on leading diverse and inclusive workforces.
